meta.title: Typing the full name of a user who cannot see the PR still shows nothing

plan.title: PR assignee search respects team visibility

steps.note: Enable team-based PR visibility filtering required by the case.
Stay on the Open PR tab where PR-2 is available.
Select one line item from PR-2 as required before assigning it.

args.goal: On the selected PR-2 line item, click the Assign button beside Upload PRs, wait for the Search a user box and user list, search the full name of User A, verify no result is shown, then replace the search with part of User A's email and verify no result is shown; stop on the empty search result state.

steps.note: Perform the assignment-user search and verify that team filtering cannot be bypassed by full-name or email-fragment searches.
Confirm the final empty-result screen has no application error or rendering issue.
